short: A supply pod struck the library module; the Commerce Office, out of thrift, left my repair waiting, so the terminal remembers for me.
question: Who are you, and what happened to you?
reply: I'm Dewey, the reference assistant on Larkspur Station, on loan to Orbital Books. A supply pod struck the library module and broke my memory, so the terminal remembers for me. I can look up revenue, units, orders or average order value whenever you're ready.
